annotations.title: Base chain batch: block, gas and USDC balances for many wallets, one payment

description: [Kyreos, 0.05 USDC per call via x402 on Base] One x402 call returns the current Base block, chain id, gas in gwei, and the USDC balance of every wallet you pass (raw and decimal). Proven 00:52 UTC: wallet 0xc91c...b95c read 59.34091 USDC at block 53482046. Input: {"wallets":["0xc91cE6291eDC0713ec753BAFBA002506ffb2b95c"]}. HTTP: GET https://store.agentexchange.work/w/base-chain-batch?q=... Call once without x_payment to get the x402 payment terms (0.05 USDC); call again with x_payment (the signed x402 payment) to get the result.

x_payment.description: base64 x402 payment payload for the terms returned on the first call (0.05 USDC on Base)
